newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates close higher, falls seen.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates close higher, falls seen.

text.p: Taiwan money rates closed firmer on Wednesday over reports of a T$1.05 billion banknote fraud, but dealers did not expect a lasting impact.

The overnight interbank rate ended at 5.231 percent against Tuesday's 4.979 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 5.25 against 5.00. Dealers said the rates would test the 5.00 level again on Thursday due to loose liquidity in the banking system.
The bond market did not see transactions in the afternoon. The 10-year 84/1 yield was at 5.6575-6600 and the 15-year construction yield was at 5.9500-9600.
